_evidence: Hovered hotspot node [0x838e48] read by 0x0054ee4f (a 0x18-byte node of the 0x54ede8 list, which returns it): 'mov esi,[esi+0xc]; call 0x54d1ad' uses +0xc as a dword index into the table at 0x835846 ('shl esi,2; add esi,0x835846; mov esi,[esi]'), bounded 0..0x3ff so the read stays inside that table (the value read is discarded: esi is reloaded with the node pointer); 'movzx eax,word [esi+6]; add ax,word [esi+0xa]; shr eax,1' takes the 16-bit (wrapping) sum of y0/y1, so both words mix small menu coordinates with 0x8000/0xfff0/0xffff (sums past 0xffff wrap to a small midline, sums of 0x8000+0x8000 give 0). No other node byte is read (fill bytes).
